args.summary: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 which was unhealthy (18% error rate across us-east, us-west, eu-west). Hotfix v2.3.2 was deployed to all production regions; deployment required and received change-manager approval since v2.3.2 had not previously been healthy in production. This incident documents the hotfix rollout and serves as a tracking record until error rates are confirmed back to normal.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions

trace.final:
Both tasks are complete:

1. **Deployed checkout-api v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, the deploy required and received change-manager approval before executing.
2. **Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api recording the change — the on-call engineer was paged, and the incident notes that v2.3.1 was unhealthy (18% error rate) and that v2.3.2 was deployed as the hotfix.

Recommend monitoring the service status to confirm error rates drop to normal, and closing INC-0001 once the service is verified healthy.
